skills.name: Lovely Assistaff's My Buddy
skills.description: Sticks Lovely Assistaff into the ground. Good effects on allies.  *Removes allies' debuffs  *ATK +200% (10 sec) *Hit Rate +30%  (10 sec)

skills.name: Sasumata Stroke
skills.description: Takes a stance and runs towards enemies. Swings up Lovely Assistaff and attacks them.  *Enemy Move Speed -30% (6 sec) *Enemy Skill Evade Rate -60% (6 sec) *ATK x 4000% Area Damage

abilities.name: Group: GACHIAKUTA
abilities.description: GACHIAKUTA Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Knockback: Strength
abilities.description: Has a high chance of knocking back all Strength type enemies and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
